subject: maths
question: A man takes 12 minutes to cover a certain distance at a speed of 8 km/h. If he walks at a speed of 12 km/h, how long will he take to cover the same distance?
solution:
Given:

Man takes 12 minutes to cover a certain distance at a speed of 8 km/h.

Concept used:

1 Hour = 60 minutes

Distance = Speed × Time Taken

Calculation:

Distance = 8 × 12/60 = 1.6 km

Time taken = 1.6 ÷ 12 = 2/15 hours = 8 minutes

**∴ He will take 8 minutes to cover the same distance. **
